description.text: A high-class pack released on 21 April 2017 that gathered 171 of the strongest and most popular cards of the XY and XY BREAK series, chosen from more than 1,000 released between December 2013 and June 2016, for players who began with Sun & Moon. Every pack held at least one Pokémon-EX, M Pokémon or BREAK Evolution, and the other cards also came in mirror holo versions. Packs held fifteen cards, two of them holo. The cards are numbered to 171, followed by seventeen extra cards numbered beyond it, among them M Camerupt-EX, N and Shaymin-EX.
